---
title: "NBA RWE Methods Portfolio"
---

This project uses NBA observational data as a sandbox for Real-World Evidence and biostatistics methods.

The portfolio is being organized around transparent study design, explicit estimands, reproducible R workflows, and careful interpretation. The goal is not to invent a new player-ranking metric. Established basketball measures such as BPM, VORP, Win Shares, WS/48, and PER will be used where they are appropriate as outcomes, covariates, descriptive measures, or sensitivity endpoints.

## First Reboot Pass

This pass creates the project foundation:

- RWE methodology roadmap
- Estimand and analysis template
- Data dictionary skeleton
- Project principles
- Future analysis directories
- Quarto site skeleton
- Next-step plan for the player-season data foundation

Substantive data acquisition and statistical analyses have not started.

## Legacy Work

The existing CourtContext / deck-building scripts and generated data are preserved as legacy material. They may be useful later for specific methods that truly require play-by-play, lineup, stint, tracking, or possession-level data.
